technical_complexity.rationale: Building on existing image generation models with an editing copilot interface is standard AI product engineering, helped by the founders' experience building Gencraft at Hive.

defensibility.rationale: Large suites (Canva, Adobe) were adding the same generative features, and the product relied on third party models with no stated proprietary data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Canva and Adobe shipped AI design features in Oct 2023, before the batch.

market_need_then: Gencraft, the founders' earlier product at Hive, reportedly reached $1M ARR in six months per the YC page, showing consumer demand for AI image generation. Demand for a copilot specifically was not independently evidenced.
